designSystem.name: Ixiptla Museum Design System
designSystem.description: Design system for Mesoamerican virtual museum with modern museum aesthetics

preserveExisting.note: Keep current DaisyUI theme colors - do not modify existing color system

principles.elegantSerif: Use serif fonts for main titles to convey cultural gravitas
principles.readableSans: Sans-serif for body text and UI elements
principles.responsiveScaling: Fluid typography that scales smoothly across devices

principles.responsiveContainers: Fluid containers that adapt to viewport
principles.masonryFlow: Pinterest-style grid for collections when content varies

hero.structure: Fullscreen with overlay text and background image/3D

navigationHeader.style: Clean minimal header with logo left, nav center, actions right
navigationHeader.background: White/transparent with subtle shadow on scroll

collectionCard.structure: Image-first with title overlay or below

categoryCard.structure: Icon + title + description in clean card
categoryCard.iconStyle: Cultural symbols or simple line icons

states.loading: Skeleton screens with cultural pattern animations
states.empty: Elegant empty states with cultural iconography
states.error: Graceful error messages with retry options

sectionStructure.header: Small overline + large title + optional description
sectionStructure.content: Grid or masonry layout with consistent cards

contentFlow.hero: Strong visual impact with clear value proposition
contentFlow.categories: Overview of main content areas with icons
contentFlow.detail: Deep-dive pages with rich media and context

mesoamericanElements.patterns: Subtle geometric patterns inspired by pre-Columbian art
mesoamericanElements.iconography: Cultural symbols for categories (pottery, sculpture, etc.)
mesoamericanElements.colorAccents: Earth tones and cultural colors within existing palette
mesoamericanElements.typography: Respect for cultural context in content presentation

modernMuseumAesthetics.minimalism: Clean, uncluttered interfaces that let artifacts shine
modernMuseumAesthetics.sophistication: Refined visual hierarchy and subtle animations

astroIntegration.components: Create reusable .astro components for each pattern
astroIntegration.islands: Use React islands for interactive elements only
astroIntegration.contentCollections: Leverage existing schema for consistent data

tailwindCustomization.utilities: Create custom utilities for spacing and typography scales
tailwindCustomization.components: Define component classes for repeated patterns
tailwindCustomization.animations: Custom animation classes for cultural transitions

threeJSIntegration.canvasLayout: Fixed 3D canvas with overlaid content sections

designPrinciples.culturalRespect: Honor Mesoamerican heritage through thoughtful design choices
designPrinciples.modernAccessibility: Contemporary UX standards with cultural authenticity
designPrinciples.performanceFirst: Optimize for mobile and slower connections
designPrinciples.scalableSystem: Components that work across all content types
designPrinciples.bilingualSupport: Seamless language switching without layout breaks
